title: NBI probes foreigners’ ‘fraudulently procured’ PH citizenship papers

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has launched a nationwide probe into foreigners’ fraudulent procurement of birth certificates, passports and other documents used as proof of Filipino citizenship, Director Melvin Matibag said Thursday.
